items.subject: calendar
items.title: Angular Calendar and DatePicker have no isDateDisabled
items.evidence: packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:218-286 (HwCalendarComponent inputs at :221-239) and :288-360 (HwDatePickerComponent inputs at :290-312): no isDateDisabled or unavailableMessage; grep isDateDisabled in packages/angular/src returns nothing. React packages/react/src/calendar.tsx:22,74; Vue packages/vue/src/calendar.ts:60,387; vanilla packages/vanilla/src/calendar.ts:37,193 have it.

remaining.angular: Add @Input isDateDisabled to hw-calendar (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:239) and apply it in tabbable (:244), select (:266), keydown (:282) and day [disabled] (:218); add isDateDisabled + unavailableMessage (required when isDateDisabled is given) to hw-date-picker (:290-310), include an "unavailable" violation in violation/validationMessage/validate (:326-342) and pass [isDateDisabled] to the nested hw-calendar (:288).

items.subject: calendar
items.title: Previous/next month buttons show two chevrons in React and Angular
items.evidence: packages/styles/src/extended.css:104 ".hw-calendar :is(.hw-calendar-prev, .hw-calendar-next):has(> :is(.hw-icon, svg))::before { content: none; }" removes the mask arrow when an inner icon is present, so React (packages/react/src/calendar.tsx:67) and Angular (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:218) show only their .hw-icon; vanilla (packages/vanilla/src/calendar.ts:91, text content, font-size 0) and Vue keep the ::before arrow. One arrow per button.
items.note: Verified by reading the selector; no browser run.

items.subject: date-picker
items.title: Vanilla DatePicker shows no visible validation message
items.evidence: packages/vanilla/src/calendar.ts:231-246 validate() only sets setCustomValidity and aria-invalid; no visible message element is created. node scratchpad/gate3/m3/tmp-dates-files-overlays/check.mjs (jsdom against packages/vanilla/dist): after typing 2026-13-45 "aria-invalid = true visible .hw-error count = 0".

remaining.vanilla: In createDatePicker (packages/vanilla/src/calendar.ts:219-246) render a .hw-error element (id added to the input aria-describedby) with the active invalid/unsupported/unavailable message, using appendDateMessage for ISO dates, or let the author supply [data-hw-date-error]; remove it on reset/destroy.

items.note: Grouped with dates-7: one DatePicker validation-message contract (element, position, live behaviour) for all four adapters.

items.subject: date-picker
items.title: Native form reset desynchronizes Angular DatePicker and Calendar
items.evidence: packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:218-360: hw-calendar and hw-date-picker register no form "reset" listener (grep reset in that file finds only password-field :37-38 and search :101-102); HwExpandedValueControl (:13-19) handles only Angular forms writeValue(null). React packages/react/src/calendar.tsx:42,87 and vanilla packages/vanilla/src/calendar.ts:176,274 and Vue packages/vue/src/calendar.ts:452 restore the default.

remaining.angular: Add a native form reset listener (queueMicrotask, respect defaultPrevented) to hw-calendar and hw-date-picker (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:219, :289) that restores the initial value, draft and month and closes the dialog; best in a shared helper on HwExpandedValueControl (:13-19) so hw-file-dropzone (:363) and hw-file-upload (packages/angular/src/forms.ts:203) use it too.

items.subject: date-picker
items.title: Initial focus when the dialog opens differs: close button vs selected day
items.evidence: React packages/react/src/calendar.tsx:99 show() only sets open; Dialog (packages/react/src/interactive.tsx:117-120) calls showModal() without moving focus into the grid. Vanilla packages/vanilla/src/calendar.ts:266 show() calls modal.show(origin) and calendar.setValue only. Vue packages/vue/src/calendar.ts:418 and Angular packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:354 (focusSelected, :247) focus the selected/tabbable day.

remaining.react: After opening (packages/react/src/calendar.tsx:99) focus the tabbable day of the nested Calendar (expose a focus handle or an initialFocus on Dialog).

items.subject: date-picker
items.title: Validation message order, size and live role differ between adapters
items.evidence: React: Field (packages/react/src/shared.tsx:108-111) label with marker, hint then error as div.hw-error, no role. Vue: packages/vue/src/calendar.ts:522-531 renders p.hw-error role="alert" inside .hw-date-picker, before the hint that decorate adds after the content (packages/vue/src/forms.ts:36-38). Angular: packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:288 label without hw-required-marker, validation p.hw-error placed before fieldEnd hint (:11), no role.

remaining.react: Decide the shared order (hint then error) and live behaviour; React already matches the Field layout.
remaining.vue: Render the validation message through the field error slot (after the hint, same element/typography as Field) and align the live role (packages/vue/src/calendar.ts:522-531).
remaining.angular: Use the shared fieldLabel with required marker (packages/angular/src/forms.ts:43) in hw-date-picker (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:288) and move the validation error after the hint, same element as fieldEnd.

items.note: Order change only; no input is renamed.

items.subject: file-dropzone
items.title: Batch validation differs per adapter: mixed-type batches and several files on a single-file dropzone produce three different outcomes
items.evidence: No shared selection helper in packages/core/src. React packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:101-108: any rejected file clears the whole selection; extra files on a single-file drop are silently dropped (slice(0,1)). Vue packages/vue/src/controls.ts:737-748: rejects the whole batch (including too many files) and emits reject. Angular packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:370-376: keeps accepted files and emits rejected for the rest. Vanilla packages/vanilla/src/controls.ts:278,284-285: slices to one file silently, rejects the batch on any invalid file.

remaining.core: Add evaluateFileSelection(files, {accept, multiple, maxSize}) -> {accepted, rejected, reason}.
remaining.react: packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:100-108 use it; report extra files as rejected.
remaining.angular: packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:368-376 use it.

items.note: Breaking: the kept/rejected files change in at least three adapters.

items.subject: file-dropzone
items.title: React and Angular FileDropzone have no size limit (maxSize); Vue and vanilla do
items.evidence: React FileDropzoneProps (packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:91-93) and Angular hw-file-dropzone inputs (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:364) have no maxSize; Vue packages/vue/src/controls.ts:704,723 and vanilla packages/vanilla/src/controls.ts:249,262-263 have it.

remaining.react: Add maxSize (bytes) to FileDropzoneProps and the accept check (packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:91,100); getRejectedMessage becomes required when maxSize is set (:93).
remaining.angular: Add @Input maxSize and apply it in accepts() (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:364,368).

items.note: Do together with the core helper of files-2.

items.subject: file-dropzone
items.title: Rejection feedback is not announced in React and absent in Vue and Angular
items.evidence: React: rejection goes to Field error (packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:97,108) rendered as div.hw-error without a live role (packages/react/src/shared.tsx:111). Vue: packages/vue/src/controls.ts:740-748 only emits reject; no getRejectedMessage prop (:698-707) and no invalid state. Angular: packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:372 only emits rejected; no message input (:364). Vanilla writes the rejection into [data-hw-file-status] (packages/vanilla/src/controls.ts:270-275).

remaining.react: Render the rejection in a persistent live region (role=status or alert) tied by aria-describedby (packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:108).
remaining.vue: Add getRejectedMessage (required with accept/maxSize), render it in a live region with aria-invalid (packages/vue/src/controls.ts:698-800).
remaining.angular: Add getRejectedMessage input (required with accept/maxSize), keep rejected state, render it in a live region with aria-invalid (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:362-376).

items.note: Breaking: a new required text input in Vue and Angular when accept or maxSize is set.

items.subject: file-dropzone
items.title: Angular FileDropzone keeps showing files after a native form reset while the input is empty
items.evidence: packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:362-381 hw-file-dropzone and packages/angular/src/forms.ts:200-213 hw-file-upload have no native form reset listener; React packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:98 and Vue packages/vue/src/controls.ts:717-720 clear their selection.

remaining.angular: Listen to the owning form reset and call update([]) when not defaultPrevented (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:363; packages/angular/src/forms.ts:203), shared with dates-5.

items.subject: file-dropzone
items.title: Dropzone layout differs visibly between adapters (label outside the zone in Vue, duplicated instruction in Vue/Angular, narrow input in React, raw byte sizes in Angular)
items.evidence: Vue: decorate wraps the .hw-file-dropzone (packages/vue/src/controls.ts:755-761) so label/hint/error are outside the zone. Angular: label and hw-file-dropzone-instruction inside the zone and an always-rendered <ul> with "name (size)" raw bytes (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:362). React: Field inside the zone, selected names as <ul> (packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:108). Vanilla: authored markup, no list. The duplicated instruction of the audit no longer exists (dropLabel is now the single required instruction in all adapters).

remaining.vue: Put label, instruction, input, status, hint and error inside one .hw-file-dropzone root (packages/vue/src/controls.ts:754-801).
remaining.angular: Drop raw byte sizes or format them; render the list only when chosen, same element as React (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:362).
remaining.react: Remove the inner Field grid that narrows the input or match it everywhere (packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:108).
remaining.all: Document one DOM contract (root, label, instruction, input, status, list?, hint, error).

items.note: Breaking: rendered markup changes in Vue and Angular.

items.subject: file-dropzone
items.title: Vanilla dropzone has no visible drag-over state
items.evidence: packages/styles/src/extended.css:89 now includes .hw-file-dropzone[data-dragover] alongside [data-dragging=true] and [data-state=dragging]; vanilla sets data-dragover (packages/vanilla/src/controls.ts:280).

items.subject: file-dropzone
items.title: Vanilla dropzone does not cancel dragover while disabled or read-only, so a blocked drop keeps the browser default
items.evidence: packages/vanilla/src/controls.ts:280 calls preventDefault on dragover only when the input is enabled and not read-only. node scratchpad/gate3/m3/tmp-dates-files-overlays/check.mjs (jsdom against packages/vanilla/dist): "files-8 disabled dragover defaultPrevented = false".

remaining.vanilla: In the dragover listener (packages/vanilla/src/controls.ts:280) always preventDefault for file drags and set dataTransfer.dropEffect="none" when unavailable; keep the availability check in drop (:283).

items.subject: file-dropzone
items.title: Read-only differs: React has none, Angular renders it as disabled, Vue keeps a focusable aria-readonly input
items.evidence: React FileDropzoneBaseProps omits readOnly (packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:91). Angular binds [disabled]="disabled || readOnly" (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:362). Vue keeps the input enabled with aria-readonly and blocks the chooser (packages/vue/src/controls.ts:790-793); vanilla uses data-hw-readonly (packages/vanilla/src/controls.ts:279-283).

remaining.react: Add readOnly: aria-readonly on the input, block click/drop, keep submission (packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:91-108).
remaining.angular: Bind [disabled]="disabled" only, add aria-readonly, prevent click when readOnly, keep drop blocked (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:362,369).

items.note: Breaking for Angular: read-only input becomes focusable and submitted.

items.subject: file-upload
items.title: Angular FileUpload lacks content projection, the required marker and most native passthrough
items.evidence: packages/angular/src/forms.ts:200-213: hw-file-upload template has no <ng-content>, uses a plain label without the hw-required-marker of fieldLabel (packages/angular/src/forms.ts:43), and binds only name/accept/multiple/disabled/required.

remaining.angular: Use fieldLabel, add <ng-content /> after the input and capture/form inputs (packages/angular/src/forms.ts:202-207).

items.subject: file-upload
items.title: FileUploadList remove button turns into a green primary button on hover; the light-mode glyph has 2.74:1 contrast
items.evidence: packages/styles/src/file-upload-list.css:50-55 gives the remove button its own hover/focus/active state (".hw-upload-item > button:not(:disabled, [aria-disabled='true']):is(:hover, :focus-visible, :active)", specificity 0,3,1) with surface-muted background and text colour, which beats the generic .hw-button hover (packages/styles/src/components.css:73, 0,3,0).
items.note: Verified by specificity reading; adapters still set data-variant="subtle" on the button, which has no rule.

items.subject: dialog
items.title: Angular hw-dialog and hw-drawer always render the footer, so a dialog without footer content shows an empty 33px shaded band
items.evidence: packages/angular/src/overlays.ts:8 (hw-dialog) and packages/angular/src/interactions.ts:61 (hw-drawer) render <footer class="hw-dialog-footer"> unconditionally; packages/styles/src/components.css:211 has no general :empty rule (only date-picker.css:35, nic-notification-dialog.css:93, navigation-drawer.css:37).

remaining.angular: Render the footer only when content is projected, or add ".hw-dialog-footer:empty { display: none }" in packages/styles/src/components.css:211 (Angular projects no nodes when nothing matches).

items.subject: drawer
items.title: Angular hw-drawer silently drops describedBy: the native dialog gets no aria-describedby
items.evidence: packages/angular/src/interactions.ts:61 hw-drawer template binds aria-labelledby only; HwDialogComponent declares describedBy (packages/angular/src/overlays.ts:11) and binds it in its own template (:8).

remaining.angular: Add [attr.aria-describedby]="describedBy || null" to the hw-drawer <dialog> (packages/angular/src/interactions.ts:61).

items.subject: tooltip
items.title: A static id on hw-tooltip is duplicated on the host and the tooltip, and aria-describedby then resolves to the host
items.evidence: packages/angular/src/overlays.ts:66-67: the input is now tooltipId ("Named tooltipId so that no id attribute is left on the wrapper element"); the span uses [id]="tooltipId" (:61); packages/angular/README.md:122 lists the rename.

items.subject: tooltip
items.title: Angular Tooltip cannot describe a button or link: it adds its own focusable wrapper, giving two tab stops and describing the wrapper instead of the control
items.evidence: packages/angular/src/overlays.ts:61: hw-tooltip still renders span.hw-tooltip-anchor tabindex="0" carrying aria-describedby with content projected inside; no directive form exists (no hwTooltip selector in packages/angular/src); README:181 still says project short noninteractive content.

remaining.angular: Add an attribute directive ([hwTooltip] on the authored button/link) that sets aria-describedby on that element and renders the tooltip, or detect a projected focusable child and move tabindex/aria-describedby to it (packages/angular/src/overlays.ts:61-70).

items.subject: accordion
items.title: Angular accordion items are text-only and keyed by id; Vue titles are strings; React accepts nodes
items.evidence: Angular HwAccordionItem is {id, title: string, content: string} (packages/angular/src/presentation.ts:50) interpolated as text (packages/angular/src/presentation.ts:91); no item template; extra groupName input (:95). Vue titles remain strings.

remaining.angular: Add title/content TemplateRef (or an hw-accordion-item child) and align the key name with React/Vue value (packages/angular/src/presentation.ts:50,91-96).
remaining.vue: Allow a title slot for rich titles.

items.note: Breaking if the Angular key is renamed from id to value.

items.subject: collapsible
items.title: Angular hw-collapsible has no disabled state
items.evidence: packages/angular/src/interactions.ts:105-106: HwCollapsibleComponent has only label, open, openChange.

remaining.angular: Add @Input({transform: booleanAttribute}) disabled, aria-disabled on the summary, prevent click/keyboard toggling (packages/angular/src/interactions.ts:105-106).

items.subject: carousel
items.title: Carousel previous/next arrows render as empty circles in forced-colours mode
items.evidence: packages/styles/src/nic-carousel.css:76-77 in the forced-colors block: ".hw-carousel-arrow::before { forced-color-adjust: none; background: ButtonText; }" and GrayText when disabled.

items.subject: carousel
items.title: Keyboard focus is dropped when Previous/Next disables itself at a bound
items.evidence: All adapters still set native disabled on the bound arrow: React packages/react/src/expanded-interactive.tsx:132, Vue packages/vue/src/expansion-interactive.ts:773-774, Angular packages/angular/src/interactions.ts:131-146 template ([disabled] on data-hw-previous/next), vanilla packages/vanilla/src/content.ts:207 (disable helper sets button.disabled).

remaining.angular: packages/angular/src/interactions.ts (hw-carousel arrows template)
remaining.all: Keep the bound arrow focusable with aria-disabled and ignore activation, or move focus to the other arrow.

items.subject: table
items.title: Angular hw-table cannot compose native rows or render custom cells; projected content is silently dropped
items.evidence: packages/angular/src/presentation.ts:99-110: HwTableColumn {key, label, rowHeader}, HwTableRow string|number only, template without <ng-content> or cell template, rows tracked by $index, fixed wrapper.

remaining.angular: Add a cell TemplateRef, a trackBy/rowKey input and native composition (ng-content or table[hwTable] directive) (packages/angular/src/presentation.ts:99-110).

items.note: Column key label vs React/Vue header remains a naming difference.

items.subject: data-table
items.title: Angular hw-data-table has no cell renderer, row key, wrapper or sort-label inputs
items.evidence: Fixed: Angular has getSortLabel (packages/angular/src/content.ts:54-55). Remaining in packages/angular/src/content.ts:48-58: text-only cells ("{{ row[column.key] }}"), track $index, fixed wrapper, single sortChange output (no sortKeyChange/sortDirectionChange).

remaining.angular: Add per-column cell TemplateRef, trackBy/rowKey, wrapper attributes, and sortKeyChange/sortDirectionChange outputs for [(sortKey)]/[(sortDirection)] (packages/angular/src/content.ts:48-58).

items.subject: container
items.title: Angular layout components drop host attributes, so documented data-variant/data-fit/data-tone and aria-label never reach the styled element
items.evidence: packages/angular/src/layouts.ts:24-46: every layout primitive except page-header and app-shell regions now puts the hw-* class and layout styles on the host (host: {class, [style]}), so data-variant, data-fit, data-tone, id and aria-* written on the element reach the styled box; hw-section handles label/aria-label/role (:46-73).
items.note: hw-page-header keeps an inner header (:86-88), documented in source.

items.subject: stack
items.title: Polymorphic element (as) exists only in Vue; React renders an invalid as="..." attribute and Angular has no equivalent
items.evidence: Angular: attribute selectors [hwContainer], [hwStack], [hwInline], [hwGrid], [hwColumns], [hwCenter], [hwAspectRatio], [hwSection] (packages/angular/src/layouts.ts:27-46) let the application choose the native element. Remaining: React nativeLayout fixes the tag and has no as (packages/react/src/expanded-layout.tsx:8-20); Angular hw-sidebar (:38), hw-spacer (:42) and hw-app-shell (:76) have no attribute form.

remaining.react: Add a typed as prop to nativeLayout and strip it from DOM props (packages/react/src/expanded-layout.tsx:8-20).
remaining.angular: Add attribute selectors for sidebar and app-shell or document the limit (packages/angular/src/layouts.ts:38,76).

items.subject: page-header
items.title: PageHeader heading level is configurable only in Vue; React and Angular always render h1
items.evidence: React PageHeader renders <h1> (packages/react/src/expanded-layout.tsx:28); Angular hw-page-header renders <h1> (packages/angular/src/layouts.ts:88-89, inputs title and description). Vue has level (packages/vue/src/layout.ts:99,113); Vue title is String only.

remaining.angular: Add @Input level (packages/angular/src/layouts.ts:88-89).

items.subject: Layout primitives
items.title: Vue writes the application class before hw-stack; React and Angular write hw-stack first.
items.evidence: Vue: mergeProps(attrs, {class}) (packages/vue/src/layout.ts:36-37) writes the application class first; React cx(`hw-${name}`, className) (packages/react/src/expanded-layout.tsx:10) writes hw-* first; Angular host class merging (packages/angular/src/layouts.ts:27-46) not verified.

remaining.angular: Check the merged class order of host class with an authored class.

items.note: Class order has no effect on the cascade; Angular part not verified.

items.subject: Calendar
items.title: Unsupported-range status on the standalone Calendar (unsupportedMessage). Vanilla createCalendar renders it with its calendar-system switch (packages/vanilla/src/calendar.ts:21,133-134) and the Vue Calendar takes the prop and renders an sr-only status when calendar is 'islamic-umalqura' (packages/vue/src/calendar.ts:57,278). React Calendar (packages/react/src/calendar.tsx:23-28) and Angular hw-calendar (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:218-287) have neither the input nor the status. The calendar-system switch itself (calendarSystemLabel, gregorianLabel, hijriLabel) is rendered on the standalone Calendar by vanilla only; React, Vue and Angular render it in DatePicker only. Corrected after the final review (m10): the entry said that only vanilla rendered any of these.
items.evidence: React Calendar props (packages/react/src/calendar.tsx:17-27) and Angular hw-calendar (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:218-239) have no unsupportedMessage and no status; Vue Calendar has it (packages/vue/src/calendar.ts:57,278); vanilla createCalendar renders the status and the calendar-system switch (packages/vanilla/src/calendar.ts:77-87,133-136). React, Vue and Angular render the switch in DatePicker only.

remaining.react: Add unsupportedMessage (required when calendar is islamic-umalqura) and an sr-only role=status (packages/react/src/calendar.tsx:17-27,66-70).
remaining.angular: Same for hw-calendar (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:218,229-239).
remaining.vanilla: Decide whether the standalone Calendar renders the switch (packages/vanilla/src/calendar.ts:77-88); either remove it there or add it to the other three.

items.note: Breaking: a new required text input on React and Angular Calendar, or a removed switch in vanilla.

items.subject: DatePicker
items.title: isDateDisabled and its validation text unavailableMessage.
items.evidence: Same as dates-2: packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:290-312 has no isDateDisabled or unavailableMessage.

remaining.angular: See dates-2.

items.subject: DatePicker
items.title: The formatted value of the selected date uses the default long date in vanilla (calendar.ts:229) and dateStyle "full" (with the weekday) in React, Vue and Angular.
items.evidence: packages/vanilla/src/calendar.ts:240 formatCalendarDate(value, {locale, calendar}) without dateStyle, so core uses year/month/day long (packages/core/src/calendar.ts:45); React packages/react/src/calendar.tsx:88, Vue packages/vue/src/calendar.ts:435 and Angular packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:316 use dateStyle "full". node scratchpad/gate3/m3/tmp-dates-files-overlays/check.mjs (jsdom against packages/vanilla/dist): "R03 formatted output = October 28, 2026".

items.subject: FileDropzone
items.title: Rejection text rendered by the component (getRejectedMessage). They only emit reject / (rejected).
items.evidence: Same as files-4: Vue packages/vue/src/controls.ts:740-748 and Angular packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:372 only emit reject/rejected.

remaining.angular: See files-4.

items.subject: FileDropzone
items.title: maxSize restriction. Vanilla has data-hw-max-size / options.maxSize (packages/vanilla/src/controls.ts:249,262-266) and Vue has the maxSize prop (packages/vue/src/controls.ts:704,723); React FileDropzone (packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx) and Angular hw-file-dropzone (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:362-363) have no size limit. Corrected after the final review (m10): the entry said vanilla only. Deferred to milestone 3.
items.evidence: Same as files-3: React packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:91-93 and Angular packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:364 have no maxSize.

remaining.angular: See files-3.

items.subject: FileDropzone
items.title: List of selected file names (<ul>) that React and Angular render; Angular also prints the raw byte size in parentheses, which React does not.
items.evidence: React renders <ul> of names (packages/react/src/expanded-controls.tsx:108); Angular always renders <ul> with "name (size)" (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:362); Vue (packages/vue/src/controls.ts:776-800) and vanilla render no list.

remaining.angular: See files-6.

items.subject: DatePicker
items.title: getDayLabel. The Vue DatePicker (packages/vue/src/calendar.ts:59,160, shared with Calendar) and the vanilla DatePicker (packages/vanilla/src/calendar.ts:193,249) accept it and pass it to the nested calendar; React and Angular expose it on Calendar only (packages/react/src/calendar.tsx:23,47 against the DatePicker props at :72-75; packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:234,258 against hw-date-picker at :288-289). Deferred to milestone 3. Recorded by the final review.
items.evidence: React DatePickerBaseProps has no getDayLabel (packages/react/src/calendar.tsx:72) and the nested Calendar is called without it (:108); Angular hw-date-picker has no getDayLabel input (:290-312) and does not bind it on the nested hw-calendar (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:288). Vue packages/vue/src/calendar.ts:59,552 and vanilla packages/vanilla/src/calendar.ts:193,249 pass it.

remaining.react: Add getDayLabel to DatePickerBaseProps and pass it at packages/react/src/calendar.tsx:108.
remaining.angular: Add @Input getDayLabel to hw-date-picker and bind [getDayLabel] on hw-calendar (packages/angular/src/advanced-controls.ts:288,290).
